newsitem.title: USA: VAALCO acquires first U.S. properties.
newsitem.headline: VAALCO acquires first U.S. properties.

text.p: VAALCO Energy Inc said Tuesday it has made its first acquisition of oil and natural gas producing properties in the United States.
The properties, acquired from Apache Corp through Northstar Interests LC for undisclosed terms, are located in the offshore Gulf of Mexico.

VAALCO said the transaction includes non-operated interests in West Cameron Block 538, Ship Shoal Blocks 105 and 149, and Vermilion Blocks 162. The transaction also includes four platforms in the High Island Block A-313/314 and High Island Block A-280 fields, all of which will be operated by VAALCO. Current net production from the involved blocks averages about 2.5 million cubic feet equivalent per day.

VAALCO, which has operations in the Philippines, India and Gabon, said it is seeking to build near term cash flow through domestic acquisitions as a bridge to the realization of returns from its longer term international projects.
